statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-21726 (GHSA-497x-rrr9-68jp, GO-2026-5115): Grafana Loki's Ruler API endpoint /loki/api/v1/rules/{namespace} checks the namespace for path traversal after only one URL decode, so a double-encoded namespace can read files on the Loki server. Loki 3.6.4 fixes it by rejecting namespace and group names that are not local paths in parseNamespace and parseGroupName in pkg/ruler/base/api.go: https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/cve-2026-21726, https://github.com/grafana/loki/commit/7733ab110ab9dc02704fec30f6afdeaa3b4180fb, https://github.com/grafana/loki/releases/tag/v3.6.4. That commit is the 3.6 release-branch backport of main-branch commit 9f5d215c0734 from pull request 20437: https://github.com/grafana/loki/pull/20437. Alloy links some Loki packages as a library, but not the Loki ruler. Read the Go function table and the bytes of /usr/bin/alloy, the only ELF file in each package, in every published alloy-dev package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository: 1.18.1-0 to 1.22.0-16, 43 versions on amd64 and 44 on arm64 (1.21.2-0 is published for arm64 only), 87 packages, each matched to the repository's SHA-256 checksum; no debug-symbol packages are published for this source. In no build does the function table contain any function from github.com/grafana/loki/v3/pkg/ruler or its subpackages, including pkg/ruler/base's API handlers, parseNamespace and parseGroupName, and a byte search of every binary finds no "grafana/loki/v3/pkg/ruler" package name, so the vulnerable Ruler API handler is not compiled in. The same searches find Loki's pkg/logql/log functions and runtime.main in every build, and find pkg/ruler/base.(*API).ListRules, parseNamespace and parseGroupName in Loki's own v3.6.3 release binaries for linux-amd64 and linux-arm64. For reference, the github.com/grafana/loki/v3 version by build is 3.7.1 in 1.18.1-0 to 1.18.1-3, 3.7.5 in 1.19.0-0 to 1.19.2-7, and the pseudo-version 3.0.0-20260915071729-5cf8c23a258d in 1.20.1-0 to 1.22.0-16. That pseudo-version is upstream Loki commit 5cf8c23a258d of 2026-09-15, which descends from 9f5d215c0734: https://github.com/grafana/loki/compare/9f5d215c0734...5cf8c23a258d
